title: SRVLOC: Fix encoding
description:
The UCS-2 to string encoding never worked. Retrieving a string and
then searching for it to find offsets also doesn't work with fuzzed
data. Just replace it. Don't bother to replace the handling for the
SLP v1 attributes that were previously supported, as it's long
obsolete, but if someone really cares it could be replaced.
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2165
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc2608
https://support.novell.com/docs/Tids/Solutions/10027163.html

Fix #20967

Tested with SRVLOC v2 file from #1833

AI-Assisted: no
